notes: Wider dual-seat cabin vs. Vanguard's single-seat cockpit. Base shape + pieces, per Docs/AssetPipeline_Modular.md — do not send this whole scene into Meshy as one generation.

base_shape.name: SteadfastCabinFrame
base_shape.description: Canopy frame + floor/walls only, no dashboard/seats/panels — those are separate pieces below. Multi-pane wide canopy, two-seat width.
base_shape.source: multi-view (front/side) through Meshy, same as ship exterior, OR procedural in Blender if the wide canopy shape proves simple enough

pieces.name: PilotSeat
pieces.description: Worn leather/composite pilot seat with high headrest, articulated frame, visible wear on edges
pieces.source_recommendation: Meshy (panel-like complexity, should do fine per kitbash pilot findings)

pieces.name: CoPilotSeat
pieces.description: Same as PilotSeat, mirrored/duplicate — reuse the same generated piece, do not regenerate

pieces.name: OverheadSwitchPanel
pieces.description: Overhead panel with two clusters of lit toggle/rocker switches, cable routing along edges
pieces.source_recommendation: Meshy 4k (panel-like, per kitbash findings this is where Meshy wins)

pieces.name: DashboardDisplayLeft
pieces.description: Flat rectangular display bezel, radar/circular readout style — intended as a RENDER TARGET surface for our own HUD, same approach as Vanguard. Generate the bezel/frame only, do not rely on AI-generated screen content.
pieces.source_recommendation: procedural in Blender (frame is simple, avoids repeating the Vanguard 'AI-generated unreadable display' mistake)

pieces.name: DashboardDisplayCentre
pieces.description: Same render-target-bezel approach as DashboardDisplayLeft, centre position

pieces.name: SidePanelRight
pieces.description: Secondary switch/status panel to the co-pilot's right, smaller lit buttons

pieces.name: CableBundle
pieces.description: Cable routing along canopy frame pillars
pieces.source_recommendation: procedural in Blender — per kitbash pilot findings, Meshy fails badly on thin elongated structures

explicit_lesson_applied: Vanguard's cockpit displays were AI-generated with unreadable blurred 'fake' text/UI, which we later replaced with render-target surfaces showing our real UMG HUD. For Steadfast we skip straight to that — display pieces above are meant as blank/simple bezels from the start, not AI-textured screens.
